description: Compares normalized committed Firestore and Storage rules with every applicable active Firebase Rules release, skipping only when no read credential is available or the only one is a Claude Code cloud session's proxy gcloud token.

rules.title: Keep active Firebase rules releases synchronized with committed rules
rules.instruction: Compare the active Firestore and Storage Rules releases with the exact committed sources after every Deploy backend run. Missing credentials may skip local or untrusted CI checks; present but insufficient credentials, missing releases, and normalized-content drift fail closed.
